title: messaging.py: _next_id never updated after POST
description: Lines 137-162: The method uses `candidate_next_id` as a local variable initialized from `self._next_id`, increments it after assigning an auto-generated ID, but never writes it back to `self._next_id`. Result: every message POSTed without an explicit `id` field receives ID 1, overwriting any previous message with that ID in `_sent`. Second POST without id will silently replace the first message.
